Grocery delivery in Aluthgama

Blynk delivers groceries and household essentials across Aluthgama, from our shop near the Dharga Town Clock Tower. Order on your phone and pay in cash at the door.

Aluthgama, close to home

Aluthgama is next door to Dharga Town and well inside our 4 km delivery area. Whether you live near the town, the railway station or the river, pin your home in the app and it shows that we deliver there before you order.

How it works

Three steps to your door.

  1. 01Pin your locationOpen Blynk and set your address in Aluthgama on the map.
  2. 02Fill your basketChoose groceries and daily essentials. The app shows the delivery fee for your address before you order.
  3. 03Pay at your doorYour rider brings the order. Pay in cash when it arrives.
